engine: Microsoft Edge neural text to speech (build-time generation)
role_handling: Woman and female student roles use female voices
Man, advisor, and technician roles use male voices
Professor, interviewer, host, and unspecified student roles alternate by context
Conversations are synthesized per speaker and joined into one question audio file
Academic talks use a slightly slower rate; conversational tasks use a natural conversational rate
input_sanitization: PDF page markers, page numbers, provider footers, section labels, and promotional copy are removed before synthesis
